rows.note: This is the casual all-purpose choice for a person, gesture, or message that feels loving.

example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 kaat1 se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 oi3

rows.note: Use this when the affection is openly intimate or physically demonstrative, especially between close partners.

example.english: They were very affectionate, hugging on the street.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺街度攬到好親熱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 laam2 dou3 hou2 can1 jit6

rows.note: Use this for mutual, friendly, or brotherly affection within a family, group, or community.

example.english: People in this community are affectionate toward one another.
example.traditional: 呢個社區嘅人彼此友愛。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 ge3 jan4 bei2 ci2 jau5 oi3

rows.note: Use this when affectionate behaviour is being described specifically as gentle or tender.

example.english: They comforted me in an affectionate, gentle tone.
example.traditional: 佢用溫柔嘅語氣安慰我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 wan1 jau4 ge3 jyu5 hei3 on1 wai3 ngo5
